description: GENERATED by scripts/termhost-bench/marker.mjs --write-golden — do not edit by hand. The contract between the JS encoder and Phase 2's raster decoder: every `valid` vector must decode to its (kind, session, seq); every `invalid` vector must be rejected with exactly its `reason`, checks running in `codec.decode_order`.

codec.digit_rule: value[i] = (value[i-1] + 1 + digit[i]) mod 8, value[-1] = 0, digit in 0..6

checksum.rule: h = 0; for d in kind,session,seq digits: h = (h * 31 + d + 1) mod 16787; written as 5 big-endian base-7 digits

codec.overlay: ESC 7, ESC [ row+1 ; col+1 H, then per cell ESC [ 48;5;<index> m SPACE, then ESC [ 0 m, ESC 8
